additional_info.subject: RE: ID0465857-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/T3314176150001] Check on Logs CRM:03055000406
additional_info.body:
Hello,
thank you for your feedback.
Yes, I was asking for the logs of today, but the client started the charge with POS and there was no energy delivery, so the charge was stopped also by POS.
Can you please check again?
Thank you

additional_info.subject: ID0465857-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/T3314176150001] Check on Logs CRM:03055000406
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Thank you for your quick response. After carefully checking the logs of today in the requested timestamp, we found that the problem laid in the OCPP.
The OCPP was offline, and that is why no connection could be established. This is why during the charging session, no energy was delivered. This connection with the OCPP failed multiple times during the 40 minutes of the timestamp. After the reboot, it seems that the connection established again.
Hereby a visual view for you to see:
Please let me know if you have any further questions, or provide me with feedback so i can close the ticket.
With best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
eMobility Technical Support Team
